section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Control and ownership for AML compliance

cards.title: 机构设定受益所有权阈值的风险为本方方法

flow_nodes.label: 机构采用风险为本的方法设定受益所有权阈值
flow_nodes.source_quote: Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach.

flow_nodes.label: 多数司法管辖区的25%受益所有权阈值要求
flow_nodes.source_quote: For AML purposes, most jurisdictions require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% or more.

flow_nodes.label: 高风险客户的可能较低阈值（可能低至10%或5%）
flow_nodes.source_quote: For certain high-risk customers, the beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5% for customers who pose a significantly higher risk.

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：机构设定受益所有权阈值（process） 受到 多数司法管辖区的25%要求（standard）和高风险下调可能性（standard）的约束；KG不足：基础KG将规则保存为事实，但未表达设定动作与标准之间的约束方向；选项判断：可确认机构设定阈值时需考虑法定基准和风险调整，排除固定阈值或忽略风险的选项；LLM推理：无。

cards.title: 最终受益所有人（UBO）的识别判断过程

flow_nodes.label: 监管义务要求识别最终受益所有人（审查所有权结构时）
flow_nodes.source_quote: When reviewing ownership structures, there is a regulatory obligation to identify the UBO of a customer.

flow_nodes.label: 机构计算直接和间接持股总比例，并与适用阈值比较，以确定最终受益所有人
flow_nodes.source_quote: In order to identify the UBOs of Company A, you need to identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership. (v7u_N000493); Individual D owns 10% of Company A directly... also own 72% indirectly... then considered a UBO with 82% shareholding. (v7u_N000494)

flow_nodes.label: 直接和间接持股信息
flow_nodes.source_quote: identify indirect ownership stakes in addition to direct ownership

flow_nodes.label: 适用受益所有权阈值（多数司法管辖区通常为25%，基于风险方法设定，高风险客户可能低至10%或5%）
flow_nodes.source_quote: most jurisdictions require beneficial ownership to be identified at a threshold of 25% (v7u_N000489); Your organization will set the appropriate threshold using a riskbased approach (v7u_N000490); For certain high-risk customers, the beneficial ownership threshold might be as low as 10% and could go as low as 5% (v7u_N000491)

flow_nodes.label: UBO识别结论（达到或未达到阈值）
flow_nodes.source_quote: Individual D is then considered a UBO with 82% shareholding of Company A. (v7u_N000494); Individual C... is not a UBO. (v7u_N000495)

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：监管义务（entry） 触发 机构计算持股并与阈值比较（process），该过程参照直接和间接持股信息（input）和适用阈值标准（standard），并 产生 UBO识别结论（exit）；KG不足：基础KG未表达从触发到判断、输入到结论的有向链；选项判断：可确认UBO识别需要综合直接/间接持股并与风险调整阈值比较，排除仅直接持股或固定阈值的选项；LLM推理：process的“计算直接和间接持股总比例并与适用阈值比较”结合了单元493的直接/间接持股要求和示例494/495的计算步骤，为完成识别功能所必需的唯一合理推导，无其他合理解释。

cards.title: 无自然人受益所有人时的替代识别

flow_nodes.label: 不存在自然人受益所有人
flow_nodes.source_quote: In companies where there is no natural beneficial owner

flow_nodes.label: 机构应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人
flow_nodes.source_quote: a controller or a notional beneficial owner should be identified and verified

flow_edges.condition: 在不存在自然人受益所有人的公司中

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：在不存在自然人受益所有人的例外条件下（entry），机构应识别并核实控制人或名义受益所有人（process）；KG不足：基础KG将此作为规则保留，但未表达条件-动作的有向结构；选项判断：可确认当无自然人UBO时必须采取替代识别措施，排除始终按持股识别的选项；LLM推理：无。
